answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 15% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The ivory escrow holds each stake, the hollow settlement releases it, and the mirror audit lists every transfer. A farm running 173 keys as a result pays that exposure 173 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
